name: curated_global_shocks
source: hand-curated from major-news year-in-review timelines (AP/Reuters/Euronews/Wikipedia/CFR), salience-screened
notes: High-salience, globally-in-awareness 2024-2026 shocks for the forward event-study. Dates are the primary news-breaking day (UTC).
caveats: Curation is judgment-based (selection); 'threat' subset (war/violence/econ) is the pre-specified primary cohort. Dates for fast-moving events = first dominant-news day. Population is multinational so 'awareness' is assumed, not measured (GDELT-coverage weighting is the upgrade).
